design: Gaussian truths with exact scores: rank-one global latent beta in (0,0.1,0.25,0.5,1), long-range precision coupling gamma in (0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4), AR(2) with second coefficient in (0,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4) at fixed lag-one correlation, site-dependent rho with amplitude in (0,0.05,0.1,0.2); arms EM-BP (AR(1) mixture kernel, misspecified), window head (torch, E03 recipe), LMMSE of the AR(1) covariance, isotropic; sizes (512, 2048); 8 seeds; all-site pooled risk against the exact score
